_about: Shi'Kahr (Glen, 4 Nov: 'build me a beautiful Shi'Kahr ... it needs to feel grand'). ONE layout read by both the map (tools/props/daz_city/shikahr_map.py) and the game (core/vulcan/VulcanCity.gd). Metres, Godot axes: x east, z south, y up. Pieces = assets/models/vulcan_city/<kit>/<piece>.gltf. yaw in degrees. The palace complex keeps the Daz designer's own arrangement (origin = the complex's front centre).

pieces.note: THE OLD GATE - the Old Quarter's west end (its back wall is solid, so it can't stand across the market canyon)

story.name: VULCAN SECURITY (office, cell, evidence, morgue) - west bridge
HALL OF ANCIENT THOUGHT - east bridge (hour of contemplation)

ground._about: The plateau the city stands on (VulcanCity.gd builds it): the UPPER CITY's ground at 'upper' (just under the Daz plinth's own top, 10.7, so the plinth hides it where they overlap), the market canyon + its two ramp trenches open down to 'market'. The desert floor is at 0 all round, below the plateau's cliff edge.

look._about: VulcanCity.gd: stone is tinted toward Vulcan red at load (multiplied into every piece's colour) - tune here, no rebuild.
